info.name: Kriraghor API: M01 Auth & RBAC
info.description: Start the API with `npm run dev` in /backend. OTP codes are printed in the server console (SMS_DRIVER=console). Paste them into the `otp` variable, and authenticator codes into `totp`. Tokens are captured into collection variables automatically. The refresh token is an httpOnly cookie, which Postman keeps for you.

request.description: Copy the 6-digit code from the server console into the `otp` variable.

exec: // Saves values from successful responses into collection variables (never throws).
let j = null; try { j = pm.response.json(); } catch (e) {}
const get = (o, path) => path.split('.').filter(Boolean).reduce((a, k) => (a == null ? undefined : a[k]), o);
const ok = pm.response.code >= 200 && pm.response.code < 300;
if (ok && j) { const v = get(j, '.accessToken'); if (v !== undefined && v !== null && v !== '') pm.collectionVariables.set('accessToken', v); }
if (ok && j) { const v = get(j, '.challengeToken'); if (v !== undefined && v !== null && v !== '') pm.collectionVariables.set('challengeToken', v); }
if (ok && j) { const v = get(j, '.signupToken'); if (v !== undefined && v !== null && v !== '') pm.collectionVariables.set('signupToken', v); }
